description: Check import cycles, boundary violations (with coverage and forbidden calls), and rule-pack policy violations. Returns the `kind: "architecture"` envelope: the finding arrays, `finding_id` values and actions of `analyze` for these issue types, with its own `schema_version`. Set `cycles`, `boundaries`, or `policy` to report one kind. Call `guard` before an edit and this tool after it. `baseline` takes a dead-code baseline. On a Rust root, it runs `cargo fallow boundaries`: `kind: "boundaries"`.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

baseline.description: Saved dead-code baseline file; only new findings are reported.

boundaries.description: Only boundary violations, coverage and forbidden calls.

changed_since.description: Report only findings in files changed since this git ref.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

file.description: Project-relative files to scope the report to.

production.description:
Production mode: exclude test, story, and dev files, only start/build
scripts, and report type-only dependencies.

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

workspace.description: Workspace packages to analyze: name or repo-relative path, comma-separated list, globs, `!` negation.

name: check_architecture
